# Grow with Google

> Google's comprehensive platform for AI training, professional certificates, and career development designed to help individuals and businesses build job-ready skills.

Grow with Google offers a range of online courses, professional certificates, and AI tools including Gemini and NotebookLM. The platform serves diverse audiences from entry-level job seekers to small business owners and educators, with programs covering cybersecurity, data analytics, digital marketing, UX design, project management, and AI fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Google Career Certificates
- Generative AI
- Gemini
- NotebookLM
- Python
- Data Analytics
- Cybersecurity
- Project Management
- UX Design
- Job-Ready Skills
- Professional Development
- AI Essentials
- SQL
- Digital Marketing
- Business Intelligence

## Core Hubs

- [Grow with Google - Training to Grow Your Business & Career](https://grow.google): Google's main hub for AI training, certificates, and career development tools
- [AI courses and tools from Google](https://grow.google/ai): Hub for all AI courses, Gemini, NotebookLM, and skill-building resources
- [Online Courses with Certificates](https://grow.google/certificates): Overview of Google Career Certificates programs for job-ready skills

## Professional Certificates

- [Google Data Analytics Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/data-analytics): Google's data analytics certificate using R, SQL, Python, and visualization
- [Advanced Data Analytics Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/advanced-data-analytics): Advanced analytics with Python, machine learning, and predictive modeling
- [Advanced Business Intelligence Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/business-intelligence): BI analysis with BigQuery, Tableau, dashboards, and data modeling
- [Google Cybersecurity Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity analyst training with Python, Linux, SQL, and SIEM tools
- [Google User Experience (UX) Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/ux-design): UX design fundamentals with AI integration and design principles
- [Project Management Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/project-management): Project management training covering Agile, Scrum, and AI integration
- [Certificate in Digital Marketing & E-commerce](https://grow.google/certificates/digital-marketing-ecommerce): Digital marketing and e-commerce training with Canva, Hootsuite, AI tools
- [Google IT Support Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/it-support): Entry-level IT support training with Python and AI troubleshooting tools
- [Build IT Automation & Python Skills](https://grow.google/certificates/it-automation-python): IT automation with Python programming, testing, and troubleshooting

## AI Training & Essentials

- [Google AI Professional Certificate](https://grow.google/ai-professional): Hands-on AI fluency with Gemini and NotebookLM for professionals
- [Learn AI Fundamentals with Google AI Essentials](https://grow.google/ai-essentials): Beginner-friendly generative AI fundamentals and productivity tools
- [Accelerate Your Job Search with AI](https://grow.google/job-search-with-ai): Job search strategy using Gemini, NotebookLM for resume and interviews

## Specialized Learning Paths

- [Learn Agile Skills with Google Agile Essentials](https://grow.google/agile-essentials): Quick Agile and Scrum fundamentals course for project management
- [People Management Essentials Certificate](https://grow.google/people-management-essentials): Leadership and people management training with AI tools for teams

## Learning for Specific Audiences

- [AI for Students: Free Study, Writing, & Career Tools & Training](https://grow.google/students): Student-focused AI training with Gemini, NotebookLM for academics
- [Generative AI for Educators](https://grow.google/ai-for-educators): Generative AI training for teachers using Gemini and NotebookLM
- [AI training and tools for small businesses](https://grow.google/ai-for-small-businesses): AI training and tutorials for small business productivity and growth
